name: Ghosts on the BBS
description: A retro bulletin-board relay has gone quiet after a suspicious login wave. On the lab network, inspect its public records and determine which account can recover the missing message. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the signal
tasks.description: A retro bulletin-board relay has gone quiet after a suspicious login wave. On the lab network, inspect its records and recover the missing message. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare the account roster with the system's older records; they may not describe the same set of users.
Cross-reference the listed accounts against the archived restoration notes to identify the production principal.
Use the password paired with the principal confirmed by both sources to sign in to the board.
